contracts.order: Actual Royal/reaction -> one equal piece spin -> apply only selected effect or arm Pawn condition/reaction -> Bishop only one actual canonical Angelic spin/grant/reaction -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Six equal piece base weights 1, each 1/6; Bishop uses canonical twenty Angelic entries/weights 1, each 1/20. No chess-rank rarity, promotion chance or special success wheel.
contracts.king: Grant one fixed named Authority (absolute command/will domination), ordinary power mode at explicit Tier 5. No Concept selector, God race/follower/Divine package, God Authority maximum or automatic mastery bonus. Persist after main None for one shared mastery.
contracts.fixedStats: Queen +1 each five numeric main stats; Knight +2 Speed only; Rook +2 Durability only. Source-keyed fixed modifiers, not actual stat rolls or mastery bonus. Register all five-stat modifiers now; calculate their numeric contribution only at finalize. Pawn uses raw values and may evolve earlier without applying its stat bonus yet.
contracts.bishop: Reuse power-angelic once, twenty canonical definitions/tiers/equal base weights; grant only the actual selected ordinary power. Import no Heavenly/Angel identity event, maximum or extra mastery.
contracts.pawn: Arm Beast of Possibility condition only, no early power/stat bonus. Original raw values and explicit frozen mastery mappings determine >=3 qualifying categories at >=7. First success gives one source-owned Royal High Paladin form/+2 each five main stats; no new Paladin/Archetype/race dispatch or repeated promotion.
contracts.mastery: King/Bishop owned powers retain one ordinary shared Power Mastery after all acquisitions; no Power Enchant/mastery-specific child wheel. Pawn passively observes that same raw draw and can grant its one stat/form milestone without another mastery/evolution spin.
contracts.ledger: Freeze piece pool/weights/version/result/effects and conditional Angelic invocation; commit selected fixed package or armed condition once. Pawn trigger freezes qualifying raw proof and commits form/five modifiers atomically under one evolution source key. Replay reuses snapshots, never duplicates grants, Divine draw or evolution.
contracts.reaction: Stack actual piece and declared effects; Pawn starts armed, not evolved. At successful trigger append Royal High Paladin, raw category proof and +2 per main stat in the result/milestone reaction. Future powers/masteries/stats remain unknown; no caption-derived funny tag.
contracts.return: Piece and optional Bishop child return to Backstory. Passive evolution restores exact current stat/mastery/event caller; final audit completes before image. Preserve normal Weapon/Power/Weakness/Apex/Title sequence and unrelated sources.
